displayName: Send a LINE message to a contact

params.name: contact
params.description: Exact LINE conversation/contact name to search for

steps.intent: Bring LINE to the foreground (or launch it) so the rest of the recipe has a window to act on.

Open LINE's search screen from whatever screen is currently showing. label (not contentDescription) because ホーム/トーク/ニュース tabs show "検索" as visible placeholder text, while VOOM/ミニアプリ expose it only via contentDescription — confirmed on-device 2026-07-12. timeoutMs raised from the 3000ms default and recoverOnZeroMatch trimmed to just scrollToTop (2026-08-31, on-device finding): a cold LINE launch (not already running) can take 5-6s to render past its splash/ad-banner before the 検索 bar exists, so the old 3000ms budget genuinely zero-matched — and the old ["back","back",...] recovery then compounded that timing miss by backing all the way out of LINE's task entirely (LINE's トーク list is the root of its own back stack when freshly cold-started via FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK from a Service context, so a second back pop falls through to whatever was underneath). scrollToTop alone still recovers a genuinely-scrolled-away screen without that destructive path.
Type the target contact/conversation name into the search field.
Tap the single exact-matching search result row to open that conversation.
Type the message body into the open conversation's message field.

Tap the send button to deliver the message. resourceId only (not also contentDescription) — the button's contentDescription is state-dependent (flips between e.g. "ボイスメッセージ"/"送信"), so pinning both risks a spurious zero-match if the observed string differs at click time; the old hand-written flow this recipe replaces matched by resourceId alone for the same reason.
